sloka: तम् दृष्ट्वा भीम संकाशम् ज्वलंतम् इव पावकम् ।वसिष्ठ प्रमुखा विप्रा जप होम परायणाः ॥१-७४-२०॥
transliteration: tam dṛṣṭvā bhīma saṁkāśam jvalaṁtam iva pāvakam ।vasiṣṭha pramukhā viprā japa homa parāyaṇāḥ ॥1-74-20॥

translations.english: In that dreadful darkness while the army looked as if covered with ashes, king Dasaratha encountered the repressor of kings, descendant of Bhrugu and son of Jamadagni with a terrible crown of matted hair, inaccessible like Kailasa mountain and unendurable like the fire at the time of dissolution. The laymen gazing at his blazing energy,hanging an axe on his shoulder and holding a bow in his hand which flashed like lighning and the principal arrow he looked like Siva at the time of slaying of Tripura.
